checkpoints.label: Backup review, all received and zero approvals

behavior.S05: Enable Begin review after at least one valid received source-code pair. Do not wait for all QxN or readiness. No automatic navigation or approval.
behavior.S05ToS06: Shared sample scheduler continues without restarting its outstanding timer. Normal new run selects question1/code101 with zero approvals; no Presenter preset or injected duplicate.
behavior.S06Loading: Per selected code, active spinner/pending clock/failed icon in clickable cells and tabs. Selected active or pending pair displays right-panel skeleton; source stays visible. Unreceived variant content/key/steps are hidden.
behavior.recovery: Continue healthy queued pairs after a failure; retry only failed pairs with run/pair/revision guards. Shared pause/resume. New run resets selection/pause; stale callbacks and unmount leases are guarded.
behavior.review: Current-pair edits/approval survive other receipts. Approval moves to next unapproved source, including pending or failed pair, keeps code. No automatic S07.
behavior.finalization: All received valid pairs plus readiness, all current approvals and current copy marks are still required.
behavior.S06Notifications: Nonmodal body-portal toasts under header/previewbar, max2 visible,5000ms each from promotion, dismiss/dedup/scope cleanup. Modal/editor errors and persistent recovery actions remain.
behavior.S00ToS01: CTA ends with S00; no CTA ghost on S01; logo/slogan450ms, card300ms with delay130ms
behavior.regenerate: Finite offsets1..8 relative to source seed; skip current/same-source other-code content; retain question and notify if unavailable
